in_marathi.name: Mulayam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Garland of flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mulayam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mulayam is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mula', meaning 'root'. This name signifies a person who is strong at the core and wears the garland of virtues. It is also associated with the god Shiva, who is known to wear a garland of flowers and skulls.
